subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge-letter options — initial asset list & upload steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: security@nimbushealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge-letter options — initial asset list & upload steps

Hi Alex / Nimbus security team,

Hope you’re well — we’re working to complete our procurement review for the Redwood Dedicated deployment and need your SOC 2 Type II artifacts to close the security review. Quick ask list below; we can accommodate whichever secure transfer option you prefer (S3 presigned, SFTP, or ShareFile).

What we typically need for an initial package (minimal intake):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the most recent audit period
- Bridge letter/management representation if the report’s period doesn’t fully overlap (or if the report is older than 12 months) — we can accept a short bridge letter (1 page) or the auditor’s permitted letter
- High-level control matrix / scope confirmation (CSV / XLSX) indicating which systems/services were in-scope
- Sampling artifacts index (list of sample IDs or filenames) and a note if any items need redaction
- Evidence transfer method and point-of-contact for any follow-ups

If helpful, I’ve attached a short SFTP/S3 upload playbook and an example bridge-letter template. Timing-wise, we’d like the initial package by EOD next Monday (2027-09-20) to keep the procurement cadence. If that’s tight, tell us which items you can deliver now and which require more time.

Security options we support (pick one):
1) Temporary S3 presigned links (preferred) — we’ll provide a unique bucket path and retention policy
2) SFTP (AWS Transfer) — we’ll provide user/key and destination path
3) Encrypted ShareFile transfer or secure WebDAV

Quick note on redactions: we only need redaction for customer-identifying data. If you redact, please include a short summary of what was redacted.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you’d like to walk through scope.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Security & Compliance Coordinator
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-s3-upload-playbook.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
- example-bridge-letter.docx (DOCX, 1 page)
- sftp-credentials-template.txt (TXT, 1 page)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbushealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-09-14T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge-letter options — initial asset list & upload steps

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide an initial package but have two clarifying questions before we upload: 

1) Audit period overlap: our latest Type II report covers 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. Do you need an additional bridge covering April–September 2027, or is a management bridge letter that confirms no material control changes sufficient?

2) Log samples: you listed sampling artifacts — can you confirm the expected format for log samples (e.g., zipped CSVs, or screenshots are acceptable)? We prefer to avoid including raw PII-bearing logs in the initial bundle.

We can provide the report PDF, the SOC cover sheet, and a control-scope matrix by your preferred transfer method. S3 presigned links would work best for us.

Alex Rivera
Head of InfoSec
Nimbus Health

Stephanie / Dev — quick templates below you can paste into the reply. I’ve also noted our preference and the short-answer to Alex’s questions.

Short answers:
- Audit period: management bridge letter is acceptable if it confirms (1) no major control changes since 2027-03-31 and (2) whether any compensating controls were added. If Nimbus prefers an auditor-signed bridge, we can accept that too.
- Log samples: ask for redacted CSV snapshots (max 48 hours of samples) OR indexed screenshots that demonstrate retention and logging controls. Do NOT request raw PII logs in the initial intake.

Reply snippet (copy / paste):
Hi Alex — thanks for the quick reply and clarifying questions. Management bridge letter is fine for our initial review; if you have an auditor-issued letter that’s great but not required. For log samples, redacted CSV snapshots (48-hour window) or screenshots that show retention/rotation are sufficient — please avoid PII in the initial upload.

If you’re able to use S3 presigned links, I’ll generate a short-lived upload path and share the link + retention policy. If you need SFTP creds, Marissa / Dev can spin that up too.

Also attaching a short example bridge-letter (one page) and the S3 playbook.

Marissa
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge-letter options — initial asset list & upload steps

Alex — appreciate the fast turnaround. Confirming next steps below so we’re all aligned: 

1) For initial intake, a management bridge letter is acceptable. If you later provide an auditor-signed bridge, we’ll swap it into the record.
2) Please provide:
   - SOC 2 Type II report PDF (most recent)
   - Scope/control matrix (CSV or XLSX)
   - Sampling artifacts index (CSV) and up to one redacted 48-hour log snapshot (CSV) OR screenshots demonstrating logging/retention
   - A short note if any item is redacted (one paragraph)

3) Transfer method: S3 presigned links preferred. We’ll create a temporary path under s3://redwood-secure-shares/nimbus_health/ with a 14-day retention and 7-day presigned upload window. If you prefer SFTP, reply with that request.

4) Timeline: if you can upload the initial bundle by 2027-09-20 EOD we’ll proceed with the procurement review; otherwise tell us which items will be delayed and an ETA.

I’ll generate the S3 path and post the presigned link in a follow-up email. Thanks again — let me know if you want a short call.

Best,
Stephanie
Security & Compliance Coordinator
Redwood Inference
